theorem identity_total_variation (a b : ℝ) (h : a ≤ b) :
  let f := id
  let interval := Set.Icc a b
  let totalVariation (g : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
    sSup {s : ℝ | ∃ (P : Finset ℝ),
      (∀ p ∈ P, interval p) ∧ a ∈ P ∧ b ∈ P ∧
      ∃ (sorted : List ℝ),
        (∀ x ∈ sorted, interval x) ∧
        (sorted.head? = some a) ∧
        (sorted.getLast? = some b) ∧
        s = (Finset.range (sorted.length - 1)).sum fun i =>
          |g (sorted.get! (i + 1)) - g (sorted.get! i)|}
  totalVariation f = b - a := sorry
